FROM THE TRAIL NOTES

Day Hike Principles

HOW TO PACK FOR A DOG-FRIENDLY DAY HIKE

The principles carry over to overnight. Pack what your dog needs per hour of movement, not per trip. A dog that runs 5 miles on a day hike needs the same water per mile on a two-night backpack.
